description:
Searches mail (full text, sender, recipient, subject, folder, date, unread, attachments) or lists a whole thread.
Returns message ids (for mail_get_email), thread, sender, date and a preview. Newest first, paging through limit/offset.
Without a filter it returns the latest messages from all folders (trash included) — for “what is new” use mailbox="inbox", unread=true.

account.description: Which account: leave empty for the signed-in mailbox, or name a shared mailbox / group you have access to (the part before @ is enough; a full address works too). mail_list_mailboxes shows what exists.

after.description: Only messages received from this date on (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601).

before.description: Only messages received up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601).

from.description: Sender (part of the name or address).

has_attachment.description: true = only messages with an attachment.

mailbox.description: Folder: inbox, sent, drafts, trash, junk, archive, or a folder name.

text.description: Full text across subject, body and headers.

thread_id.description: List every message of this thread (threadId from an earlier result); other filters are then ignored.

to.description: Recipient (part of the name or address).

name: mail_search_emails
title: Search messages
